JACKKNIFE

A downloadable game for Windows, macOS, and Linux

Download NowName your own price

JACKKNIFE is a psychological horror visual novel set in the highways of rural America. You play a lone hitchhiker trying to outrun your past when a charming truck driver named Jackie offers you a ride. But as snow begins to fall, you sense that your rescuer might be far more dangerous than you expected.

Features:

  • 13,900 words
  • 9 cgs
  • Branching narrative paths based on choices

The Characters:

Jackie

Player:

You play as a lonely hitchhiker. A woman, though who she is and what she’s running from are left to you.  There are no pronoun options, and the story uses feminine terms like 'lady' when referring to you.  Your appearance is never shown directly, but your style of dress is more feminine, like references to wearing skirts and make-up.

Content warning: 

Jackknife contains depictions of blood, death, stalking,  manipulation, and predation. This game explores mature subject matter intended for adult audiences. Minor sexual themes, but no explicit graphic sex is depicted.

Future Plans:

Due to all the interest in the game, JACKKNIFE will be continued! An update is planned to hopefully release at the end of the year! See this devlog for more details.

I’ve had this concept for a few years now, but I took the opportunity this year to practice branching paths in a visual novel in a way I haven’t before. I do have some future ideas for this game, but I wouldn’t call it a demo, as I don’t currently plan to finish it , it was more of a writing exercise. However, if there’s enough interest, I might continue it!

For now, feel free to check out my other games. I recently released a remake of my lesbian dating sim from years back, check it out here: https://llonelly.itch.io/monster-sweethearts-recut

Join my Patreon if you also want to support me further: https://www.patreon.com/cw/llonelly

In general, thank you so much for your support and for taking the time to play. Thanks!

I played through the entire demo in one sitting, and then greedily went back and dug through every single branch because I simply couldn’t get enough. You created this incredibly immersive experience and interpretation of a character who is psycho, broken, comfort-eager, yet also so gentle, charming, effortlessly composed, and emotionally expressive—and as a lesbian, I am absolutely burning over her. What kind of magic did you put into this game??? Why does it feel so damn HOT.

The pacing is honestly perfect. Nothing feels unnecessarily dragged out, and the progression is so engaging that when the demo ended, I just sat there for a while in genuine separation anxiety, then immediately started reloading saves so I could keep experiencing all the different branches. 😭

Please, please keep updating this game. I’ll be waiting for every single update!!! I’m already completely hooked. Thank you so much for making Jackie the way she is. ❤️
